entities.summary: John Michael Evans is a Canadian technology executive and the President of Alibaba Group. He previously spent 20 years working for U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs and is a former Olympic rower. J. Michael Evans was a performers & entertainers from Toronto (b. 1957-08-16, Toronto). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
